title: A randomized trial of icatibant in ACE-inhibitor-induced angioedema
authors: Baş M, Greve J, Stelter K, Havel M, Strassen U, Rotter N, et al.
population: Patients at German university hospitals with ACE-inhibitor-induced angio-oedema of the upper aerodigestive tract (per-protocol population)
funder: Funded by Shire and the Federal Ministry of Education and Research of Germany (statement in the published abstract). The registry names the Technical University of Munich as lead sponsor.
result: Phase 2, double-blind, double-dummy trial of icatibant 30 mg subcutaneously, a bradykinin B2 receptor antagonist, against intravenous prednisolone 500 mg plus clemastine 2 mg. Median time to complete resolution of oedema 8.0 hours against 27.1 hours (P=0.002); complete resolution within 4 hours in 5 of 13 against 0 of 14. Three patients on standard therapy required rescue treatment and one required tracheotomy.
